tagline: Global leader in commercial aircraft, defense, space and security solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The BCA segment represents approximately 46% of total revenue and is the primary driver of financial growth and volatility, with significant leverage tied to aircraft deliveries and the post-crisis recovery of the air travel market.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue generated from the sale of commercial aircraft such as the 737, 777 and 787.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound following the 2024 quality crisis
kpis.description: Revenue increased significantly in 2025 due to higher delivery volumes, despite disruptions related to the 737-9 incident in 2024.

kpis.explanation_en: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.signal: Return to profitability after three years of losses
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from -16.1% in 2024 to 4.8% in 2025, driven by production recovery and increased deliveries.

kpis.explanation_en: Consolidated total revenue from all combined segments.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 34.5% in 2025, driven by BCA, BDS and BGS, despite production disruptions.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from military contracts, satellites, defense systems and space programs.
kpis.description: The BDS segment saw revenue growth in 2025 due to reduced negative contract adjustments and improved operational performance.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from maintenance, training, spare parts and digital services for commercial and military customers.
kpis.description: BGS shows steady growth, driven by demand for commercial and government services.

kpis.explanation_en: Operating income excluding exceptional items such as pension-related charges.
kpis.description: Core operating earnings improved from -$11.8B in 2024 to +$3.2B in 2025, reflecting operational stabilization.

kpis.explanation_en: Measures the total value of future orders Boeing has yet to deliver, an indicator of commercial health.
Number of Boeing 737 aircraft delivered to customers each period, a key indicator of revenue and production.
Number of Boeing 787 aircraft delivered to customers, a key indicator of production and revenue.
Number of 737 MAX aircraft produced per month. Indicates whether Boeing is recovering production after crises.
Measures the actual cash generated by Boeing's operations each year, showing its true ability to generate cash.
Actual cash Boeing generates after paying expenses, showing its ability to invest or repay debt.
Measures the profitability of Boeing's Defense division: the percentage of profit generated per dollar of sales.
